positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Spearheaded the design and implementation of performance optimizations across existing features, achieving a 97% reduction in load times, while simultaneously minimizing technical debt and cutting unnecessary costs.
Led daily scrums and assumed key leadership responsibilities, including delegating tasks during high-priority incidents, preparing comprehensive resource documentation to enhance support for team members across the HD Online organization, and mentoring junior engineers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Participated in implementation of B2B/Pro customer-targeted features across interconnected commerce applications like cart, checkout, and account management for the online experience.
